## 📝 Sharaxaadda PR-ga (PR Description)
<!-- Sharax si kooban oo cad waxa la bedelay iyo sababta -->

## 🔗 Issue-ka La Xiriira
<!-- Xidh issue-ga PR-ga xallinayo -->
Closes #

## 🔄 Nooca Isbedelka (Type of Change)
<!-- Calaamadee waxa khuseeya -->
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (isbedel aan si xun u jirin waxa cusub ka dilaacsada)
- [ ] ✨ Feature cusub (isbedel si xun u jirin waxa cusub ka dilaacsada)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix ama feature oo keeni doona in waxa jira u shaqayn waayo)
- [ ] 📚 Dukumenti kaliya
- [ ] 🔧 Refactor (isbedel code ah oo aan feature cusub aheyn ama bug-fix aheyn)
- [ ] ⚡ Waxqabadka hagaajinta (performance improvement)

## 🧪 Tijaabooyin (Testing)
<!-- Sharax tijaabiyada aad samaysay si aad u xaqiijiso isbedeladaada -->
- [ ] Tests cusub ayaan ku daray
- [ ] Tests hore la cusbooneysiiyay
- [ ] Dhammaan tests-yadu waa guulaystaan locally

## ✅ Liiska Hubinta (Checklist)
- [ ] Code-kaygu wuxuu raacayaa qawaaniinta mashruuca
- [ ] Self-review ayaan u sameeyay code-kayga
- [ ] Faallooyinkii qoraalka ah ee adag ayaan ku soo daray
- [ ] Dukumentiga la xiriira ayaan cusbooneysiiyay (haddii loo baahdo)
- [ ] Isbedeladaydu kuma dhalaalaan digniin cusub
- [ ] Tests cusub ayaan ku daray oo xaqiijinaya in xallinta shaqeynayso
- [ ] Tests cusub iyo kuwa hore labaduba waa guulaystaan locally
